name: clarify-first
description: On complex tasks and deep questions, Claude first asks you 2-4 high-leverage multiple-choice questions, then works to that spec. Everyday prompts pass untouched.

detector.title: Complexity detector
detector.description: hybrid: free keyword scoring, and a tiny Haiku check only for borderline prompts. heuristic: keyword scoring alone, zero tokens. model: Haiku checks every prompt over 60 characters.

maxQuestions.title: Most questions per round
maxQuestions.description: The most questions Claude asks before starting (1 to 4).
